title: They fought over positions… while the King was on His way to the cross.
paragraphs: They fought over positions… while the King was on His way to the cross.
While Jesus Christ was preparing to bleed, His disciples were arguing about who would be greatest (Luke 22:24).
And Jesus flips the table without raising His voice.
“The greatest among you should be like the youngest… the one who rules like the one who serves.” (Luke 22:26)
Ministry was never a throne to sit on.
It’s a towel to pick up.

Some people today treat calling like a crown.
“My ministry.”
“My platform.”
“My people.”
The moment you think it’s yours… you’ve already stepped out of alignment.

Because the Church belongs to Christ.
The calling comes from Christ.
The glory returns to Christ.
A vessel that bleeds grace you didn’t earn.
And that’s where grace walks in.

Because even those prideful disciples—
the ones arguing, comparing, posturing—
Still used their lives to shake the world.

You don’t qualify for ministry by position.
You’re invited into it by mercy.
So if God has entrusted you with influence, a pulpit, a platform, or even one soul…
Because the moment it becomes about you…
